brief: The canvas is filled with many interlocking, irregularly shaped puzzle pieces, initially scattered across the frame. Each piece displays a fragment of a larger picture. The viewer can click and grab any individual piece, using a dragging motion to move it across the canvas. When the viewer releases the piece, it attempts to lock into place with neighboring pieces, forming continuous sections of the image.

statement: This sketch presents an interactive puzzle experience where users can drag irregularly shaped pieces across the screen. Each piece displays a fragment of a larger image, and when released near other locked pieces, it attempts to snap into place, forming continuous sections. The implementation uses a combination of geometric shapes for piece boundaries and image slicing to create a cohesive visual puzzle. The interface allows for intuitive manipulation while maintaining the structural integrity of the completed puzzle through proximity-based snapping mechanics.
